examples: I throw away the trash every evening.
I threw away the trash yesterday.
I've already thrown away the trash.
note: «Throw away» = викидати непотрібне. Просто «throw» — кидати (м'яч), не сміття. Із займенником частка йде після нього: «throw it away» / «throw it out», а не «throw away it».

examples: I throw out old food every week.
I threw out the broken chair yesterday.
I've thrown out three bags of trash already.
note: Практично те саме, що «throw away» — вибір частки (out/away) не міняє суті. Головне правило те саме: з займенником — «throw it out», не «throw out it».

examples: I forgot my keys this morning.
note: «Forget to do» — забути зробити щось (наперед). «Forget doing» — забути, що вже робив.

examples: I remembered his birthday just in time.
note: «Remember to do» — не забути зробити. «Remember doing» — пам'ятати, що робив.

examples: I bought a new laptop last week.
I've bought too many books this year.
Can you bring your laptop tomorrow?
He's brought his dog to work again.
note: «Bring» — сюди (до мовця). «Take» — туди (від мовця).

examples: I take the bus every morning.
I took my dog for a walk.
note: Див. різницю bring/take вище.

examples: I go to the gym twice a week.
I went to the gym yesterday.
note: «I've been to Kyiv» — їздив і повернувся. «He's gone to Kyiv» — поїхав і ще там.

examples: I do my chores on Sundays.
I've done everything on the list.
note: «Do» — виконувати дію/обов'язок. «Make» — створювати щось нове.

examples: I've made this recipe many times.
note: Див. різницю do/make вище.

examples: I've gotten used to the cold winters.
note: «Get» має купу значень — отримувати, ставати, приходити. Орієнтуйся по контексту речення.

examples: I give him a ride every day.
I gave her my old phone.
note: «Give up» — кинути / відмовитись від чогось. Із займенником: «give it up», не «give up it».

examples: I put my keys on the table every day.
I put my keys on the table yesterday.
I've put it in the wrong place again.
note: Форма однакова у всіх часах — слухай контекст (every day / yesterday / already).

examples: I run three times a week.
I've run this business for two years.
note: «Run a business» — керувати бізнесом, не тільки бігати.

examples: I drive to work every day.
I've driven this Jeep for years.
I ate breakfast an hour ago.
I drank too much coffee today.
note: Не плутай з «drunk» як прикметником (п'яний).

examples: I break things when I'm tired.
note: «Break down» — ламатись (про техніку) або зривати нерви.

examples: I caught a cold last week.
I've caught up on all my emails.
note: «Catch up» — наздогнати / встигнути зробити.

examples: I wear a jacket in winter.
I wore my old boots yesterday.
I've worn this shirt too many times.
note: «Wear out» — зношувати (річ) або сильно втомитись. Із займенником: «wear them out» (напр. про взуття), не «wear out them».

examples: I met him at the gym.
I left my umbrella at work.
I've left this job once already.
note: Не плутай дієслово «left» (past) з прикметником «left» (лівий).

examples: I come home late on Fridays.
I've come to this cafe many times.
I knew him back in college.
I've known her for ten years.
note: «Know» не вживається у Continuous — не кажемо «I'm knowing».

examples: I've thought about this for a while.
note: «Think about» — роздумувати над чимось. «Think of» — щось спадає на думку.

examples: I saw a moose near the farm.
note: «See» — мимоволі бачити, «watch» — дивитись цілеспрямовано, «look» — глянути.

examples: I say hello to my neighbors.
note: «Say something» — без особи-об'єкта. «Tell someone something» — обов'язково з особою.

examples: I tell my dogs to sit.
note: Див. різницю say/tell вище.

examples: I lost my wallet last week.
note: «Lose» (губити) не плутай з «loose» (вільний, прикметник) — часта помилка написання.

examples: I take out the trash every evening.
I took out the trash this morning.
I've already taken out the trash.
note: «Trash» (US) і «rubbish» (UK) — синоніми. «Garbage» теж американський варіант.

examples: I do my chores on Saturdays.
note: Завжди вживається у множині.

examples: I've done three loads of laundry.
note: Кажемо «do the laundry», не «wash the laundry».

examples: I've bought all the groceries for the week.
I've paid all my bills this month.
note: «Bill» — рахунок за послуги. «Receipt» — чек за покупку. Це різні речі.

examples: I have a deadline every Friday.
I missed the deadline last month.
I commute to work by car.
I've commuted this route for years.
I've had three appointments this week.
note: «Appointment» — запис на конкретний час. «Meeting» — ділова зустріч.

examples: I ask for a refund if it's broken.
I got a refund last week.
I've never gotten a refund from them.
This laptop has a two-year warranty.
I cancelled my subscription last month.
I've had this subscription for a year.
I send an invoice every month.
I've sent three invoices this week.
note: «Invoice» — для бізнесу. «Bill» — побутовий рахунок.

examples: I set a reminder for meetings.
I've run all my errands already.
note: «Run errands» — займатись дрібними справами (пошта, магазин тощо).

examples: The bill was overdue last month.
I've never had an overdue bill.
I do maintenance on my Jeep every spring.
I've done all the scheduled maintenance.
I've kept all my receipts this year.
note: Див. різницю bill/receipt вище.

examples: I schedule my week on Sundays.
I've scheduled everything for next week.
I've paid off part of my mortgage.
I pay rent on the first of the month.
I've never been late on rent.
note: «Rent» — платити оренду. «Lease» — довгостроковий договір оренди.
Формальніший синонім — «start», взаємозамінні в більшості контекстів.

examples: They build houses in this neighborhood.
We've built a good relationship with our neighbors.
note: Часто переносно — «build a relationship/career», не тільки про будівлі.

examples: I always choose the window seat.
note: Не плутай «choose» /tʃuːz/ (дієслово) з «chose» — це вже минулий час, а не інше слово.

examples: I cut my own hair sometimes.
I've already cut the budget for this month.
note: Форма однакова у всіх часах — слухай контекст.

examples: I fell on the ice last winter.
Gas prices have fallen this month.
note: «Fall for» — закохатись або повестись на щось (обман).

examples: I always find good deals online.
I found my keys under the couch.
I've found a great new mechanic.
I fly home twice a year.
I flew to Toronto last week.
I've flown this route many times.
I forgave her a long time ago.
I've forgiven him, but I haven't forgotten.
I hang my coat by the door.
I hung the picture on the wall.
I've hung all the laundry to dry.
note: «Hang out» — проводити час з кимось неформально.

examples: I hear him every morning through the wall.
I heard a strange noise last night.
I've heard that song a hundred times.
note: «Hear» — мимоволі чути, «listen» — слухати цілеспрямовано. Та сама логіка, що see/watch.

examples: I hide the good snacks from the kids.
I hid the gift in the closet.
I've hidden the spare key outside.
I hold the door for people behind me.
I held the baby for an hour.
I've held this position for two years.
note: «Hold on» — почекати. «Hold a job/position» — обіймати посаду.

examples: My back hurts after long drives.
I hurt my shoulder at the gym.
I've hurt my knee twice this year.
note: Форма однакова у всіх часах.

examples: I keep my receipts in a folder.
I've kept this habit for years.
note: «Keep doing» — продовжувати робити щось.

examples: I lend tools to my neighbor sometimes.
I've never lent money to a stranger.
note: «Lend» — давати в позику (я комусь). «Borrow» — брати в позику (я в когось).

examples: I read the news every morning.
I read that book last month.
note: Пастка: пишеться однаково в усіх формах, але минулий час звучить як «red» /rɛd/, не /riːd/.

examples: I ride my bike to work in summer.
I rode the ferry to the island.
I send invoices at the end of the month.
I set the table before dinner.
note: Форма однакова у всіх часах. «Set up» — налаштувати щось.

examples: I sit by the window at work.
I sat in traffic for an hour.
I sleep about seven hours a night.
I haven't slept well this week.
I've spoken to the landlord about it.
note: «Speak» — трохи формальніше за «talk», часто про мови чи офіційні розмови.

examples: I spend too much on groceries.
I spent the whole weekend fixing the fence.
I've spent all my savings on the car.
note: Про гроші й час однаково — «spend money» / «spend time».

examples: I stand all day at this job.
I stood in line for an hour.
I've stood here before, this line never moves.
note: «Can't stand» — терпіти не можу (ідіома, не про фізичне стояння).

examples: Someone steals packages from porches around here.
Someone stole my bike last week.
My wallet has been stolen twice.
note: Не плутай зі «still» /stɪl/ — «досі», геть інше слово.

examples: I teach my kids to drive on weekends.
I've taught him everything I know.
note: «Teach» — навчати когось. «Learn» — вчитись самому.

examples: I didn't understand him at first.
I wake up at 6 every day.
I woke up late this morning.
I've woken up early all week.
note: «Wake up» — прокинутись (сам). «Wake someone up» — розбудити когось.

examples: Our team rarely wins on the road.
We won the game last night.
We've won three games in a row.
note: «Won» /wʌn/ звучить так само, як «one» — різні слова, той самий звук.

examples: I write in a journal every night.
I wrote him a long email.
I always apologize first, even when it's not my fault.
note: Канадське/американське написання — apologize (не apologise). «Apologize for doing something».

examples: I work the night shift on weekends.
I worked a double shift yesterday.
I've picked up an extra shift this week.
note: Колокація: night shift, double shift, pick up a shift.

examples: I ask for a raise once a year.
I got a raise last month.
I've never gotten a raise here.
note: Американське/канадське слово; британський відповідник — a rise.

examples: I had lunch with a coworker yesterday.
I've become good friends with a few coworkers.
I get my paycheck every two weeks.
I change my password every few months.
I've already reset my password twice this week.
I sat in traffic for an hour yesterday.
I've never seen traffic this bad.
note: Незлічуваний.

examples: I get a parking ticket at least once a year.
I got a parking ticket yesterday.
I've gotten two parking tickets this month.
I renew my driver's license every five years.
I renewed my driver's license last month.
I've had my driver's license for ten years.
note: Написання license — американське/канадське; британське — licence (іменник).

examples: The dog bit the mailman yesterday.
My gums bleed when I floss.
The cut bled for a few minutes.
It hasn't bled since this morning.
The wind blows hard here in winter.
The wind has blown all the leaves off the porch.
note: «Blow it» — зіпсувати шанс (розмовний вираз).

examples: I deal with customer complaints every day.
I dealt with it right away.
note: «Deal with» — розбиратись з проблемою/ситуацією.

examples: We dig the garden every spring.
I dug a hole for the fence post.
I've already dug three holes today.
She draws every day after school.
I drew up a quick plan.
I've drawn this map from memory.
note: «Draw up» — скласти (план, документ).

examples: We fought about the schedule last week.
I've fought for this promotion for a year.

note: Часто про техніку — «my computer froze».

examples: The company grew fast last year.
The business has grown a lot since 2020.
I lay the table before guests arrive.
I laid the blanket on the grass.
I've laid out all the tools I need.
note: Не плутай з «lie» /laɪ/ (лежати самому) — «lay» завжди вимагає об'єкт.

examples: She leads the team on this project.
She's led this department for three years.
note: Не плутай з металом «lead» /lɛd/ — пишеться так само, як минулий час цього дієслова.

examples: We light candles for dinner sometimes.
I lit the fireplace last night.
This word means something different in Canada.
I meant to call you earlier.
I've always meant to visit that museum.
note: «Mean to do» — мати намір щось зробити.

examples: The phone rings constantly at work.
The alarm has rung three times already.
The sun rose at 6 this morning.
Costs have risen sharply this year.
note: «Rise» не бере прямий об'єкт («ціни зростають»), «raise» бере («хтось піднімає ціни»).

examples: The company seeks new talent every year.
I sought advice from a lawyer.
I've sought help from a few different people.
note: Формальніший синонім — «look for».

examples: My hands shake when I'm nervous.
The whole house shook during the storm.
The news has shaken the whole team.
The sun shines almost every day in summer.
The sun has shone for a week straight.
We shoot the weekly video on Fridays.
We shot the whole scene in one take.
We've shot half the footage already.
note: Дуже часто про фото/відео — «shoot a video», не тільки про зброю.

examples: I show new hires around on their first day.
I've shown her the ropes already.
note: Дієприкметник — shown, а не «showed» (частий помилковий варіант).

examples: This fabric shrinks in hot water.
My sweater shrank in the dryer.
The budget has shrunk this quarter.
She sings in the car every morning.
The choir sang beautifully last night.
I've sung this song a hundred times.
Morale sinks after news like that.
The boat sank near the harbor.
Prices have sunk since last quarter.
The car slides on ice if you brake hard.
I slid on the icy steps.
Sales have slid for three months straight.
News spreads fast in a small town.
The rumor spread through the office.
The news has already spread to the whole building.
note: Форма однакова у всіх часах.

examples: This drawer sticks when it's humid.
My car got stuck in the snow.
I've been stuck in traffic for an hour.
note: «Stick to» — дотримуватись (плану, дієти).

examples: I swear I locked the door.
He swore he'd never do it again.
I've sworn off fast food this month.
I sweep the porch every weekend.
I swim three times a week.
I tore my jacket on the fence.
I've torn this page out already.
note: Не плутай з іменником «tear» /tɪr/ (сльоза) — те саме написання, інша вимова.

examples: We book a babysitter every Friday night.
We hired a babysitter last weekend.
We've used the same babysitter for years.
I text my landlord when something breaks.
I called the landlord about the leak.
I've never had issues with this landlord.
The new tenant moved in last week.
I've been a tenant here for three years.
I call the same plumber every time.
The plumber fixed the leak yesterday.
note: «B» не вимовляється: /ˈplʌmər/, не «плумбер».

examples: An electrician checks the wiring every few years.
I've hired an electrician twice this year.
I keep the thermostat low at night.
I turned the thermostat up this morning.
I've already adjusted the thermostat twice today.
This faucet has a small leak.
We found a leak under the sink yesterday.
We've fixed two leaks this year.
note: Може бути й дієсловом — «the roof leaks».

examples: I refill this prescription every month.
I picked up my prescription yesterday.
I've already refilled it twice this year.
I get a checkup once a year.
I had a checkup last month.
I've had my checkup already this year.
Stress often shows up as physical symptoms.
I noticed the symptoms a few days ago.
The symptoms have gotten worse this week.
I apply for a few jobs every week.
I applied for this position in June.
I've applied to five companies so far.
note: «Apply for» — подавати заявку на щось (роботу, гранту).

examples: I quit my job last month.
note: Форма однакова у всіх часах. «Quit doing something» — кинути щось робити.

examples: She resigned from her position last week.
note: Формальніший за «quit», часто про керівні посади.

examples: She's retired from teaching after thirty years.
The manager fires people without much warning.
They fired half the team last quarter.
He's been fired from two jobs this year.
note: Протилежність — hire.

examples: They hired me on the spot.
We've hired three new people this month.
note: Протилежність — fire.

examples: I always negotiate the price at the dealership.
I negotiated a better rate with my landlord.
I've negotiated my salary twice at this job.
Customers complain about the wait times.
I complained to the manager about the noise.
I've complained about this twice already.
note: «Complain about» — скаржитись на щось. Іменник — a complaint.

examples: I renew my passport every ten years.
I renewed my lease last week.
I've already renewed my licence this year.
I cancel plans when the weather's bad.
I've already cancelled my gym membership.
note: Написання cancelled з двома «l» — канадський/британський стандарт (розділ 5).

examples: The system confirms every booking by email.
I confirmed the reservation this morning.
We reschedule meetings all the time.
I rescheduled the appointment for Friday.
I've already rescheduled twice this week.
We postpone the trip whenever it rains.
They postponed the event because of the storm.
We've postponed the meeting twice already.
I arrived a few minutes late.
note: «Arrive at/in», не «arrive to».
Формальніше за «leave», типово для розкладів.

examples: I park on the street most days.
I parked in the wrong spot.
We insure the car through the same company every year.
I insured the house right after we moved in.
note: Іменник — insurance.

examples: I rarely claim anything on my insurance.
I claimed the damage after the storm.
I've never claimed anything before this.
note: Іменник — a claim (страхова заява).

examples: I deposit my paycheck every second Friday.
I deposited the cheque this morning.
I've already deposited the rent for next month.
note: Також іменник — «a deposit» (застава, задаток).

examples: I withdraw cash from this ATM.
I withdrew a hundred dollars yesterday.
I've withdrawn too much this month.
I transfer money to my savings every payday.
I transferred the funds this morning.
note: Як іменник наголос переходить на перший склад: a transfer /ˈtrænsfɜr/.

examples: I invest a bit every month.
I invested in an index fund last year.
I've invested most of my savings already.
I borrow tools from my neighbor sometimes.
I borrowed twenty dollars from him.
I've never borrowed money from a stranger.
note: Протилежність — lend.

examples: I owe my brother fifty dollars.
I owed rent that whole month.
I've owed him this for way too long.
note: Звучить так само, як «oh» — не плутати на слух.

examples: We can't afford a vacation this year.
I couldn't afford the repair last month.
I've never been able to afford that neighborhood.
note: Майже завжди з can/can't.

examples: We donate old clothes every spring.
I donated to the food bank last week.
I've already donated blood twice this year.
I volunteer at the shelter on weekends.
I volunteered at the food bank last month.
I've volunteered here for two years now.
note: Також іменник — «a volunteer» (волонтер).

examples: I lie down for twenty minutes after work.
I lay down as soon as I got home.
I've lain down for an hour and still can't sleep.
note: Найплутаніша пара в англійській: «lie» (лежати самому, без об'єкта) проти «lay» (класти щось, з об'єктом). Плюс минулий час «lie» — це саме «lay», що збігається з базовою формою іншого дієслова.

examples: My boss lets us work from home on Fridays.
I let my kid stay up late last night.
I've never let him borrow the car before.
note: Форма однакова у всіх часах. «Let someone do something», без «to».

examples: The results prove the theory works.
He proved his point with the receipts.
She's proven herself many times at this job.
note: Дієприкметник — proven або proved, обидва вживані.

examples: The store shuts at 9 on weekdays.
I shut the window before the storm.
I've already shut all the blinds.
note: Форма однакова у всіх часах. «Shut down» — закритись (про бізнес) або вимкнутись (про техніку).

examples: We split the bill evenly every time.
We split the cost of the gift.
We've already split the rent for this month.
note: Форма однакова у всіх часах.

examples: Prices swing a lot in this market.
He swung the bat and missed.
Public opinion has swung the other way.
She bore the criticism without complaint.
I've borne worse than this before.
note: «Can't bear» — не терпіти, ненавидіти. Не плутати з твариною «bear» /bɛr/ — звучить так само.

examples: I bent down to tie my shoe.
The frame has bent slightly from the weight.
This pipe bursts every winter if it's not insulated.
The balloon burst right in my hand.
A pipe has burst in the basement.
note: Форма однакова у всіх часах.

examples: I feed the dog at 7 every morning.
I fed the cat before I left.
The service forecasts snow for the weekend.
They forecast rain, but it stayed dry all day.
They've forecast a mild winter this year.
note: Форма однакова у всіх часах. Як іменник — «the forecast» (прогноз погоди).

examples: We signed the lease last spring.
We've broken a lease once before.
note: Довгостроковий договір оренди, на відміну від щомісячного «rent».

examples: We do a small renovation almost every year.
We finished the kitchen renovation last month.
We hire the same contractor every time.
The contractor finished ahead of schedule.
I've already called three contractors for quotes.
The furnace runs constantly in January.
The furnace broke down last winter.
I've already had the furnace serviced this year.
I split rent with my roommate.
My roommate moved out last month.
I've had three roommates this year.
I wave to my neighbor every morning.
I met my new neighbor yesterday.
I've never really spoken to that neighbor.
note: Написання neighbor — американське; канадське/британське — neighbour.

examples: I walk around the neighborhood every evening.
We explored the new neighborhood last weekend.
I've lived in this neighborhood for six years.
note: Написання neighborhood — американське; канадське/британське — neighbourhood.

examples: I rent a small apartment downtown.
We moved into this apartment last year.
I've lived in this apartment for two years.
We store the extra furniture in the basement.
We've finished half the basement already.
The kids play in the backyard after school.
We had a barbecue in the backyard yesterday.
I shovel the driveway every snowfall.
I parked in the driveway last night.
I've already cleared the driveway this morning.
I keep my tools in the garage.
I parked in the garage because of the storm.
I've already cleaned out the garage this year.
I pick up my prescription at this pharmacy.
I stopped by the pharmacy on my way home.
I've already been to the pharmacy today.
I see the dentist twice a year.
I went to the dentist yesterday.
I've already booked my next dentist appointment.
My allergy acts up every spring.
My allergy was worse than usual last week.
I've had this allergy since childhood.
I get the flu vaccine every fall.
I got the vaccine last week.
I've already gotten this year's vaccine.
I switched insurance providers last year.
I've had this insurance for three years.
note: Незлічуваний.

examples: I get the flu almost every winter.
I had the flu last week.
